page.content:
Genetically built emperor who seizes Cobra from Cobra Commander.

How Serpentor connects

  • Creator: Dr. Mindbender — Dr. Mindbender genetically builds Serpentor from the DNA of conquerors.
  • Character: Cobra Commander — Serpentor's coup splits Cobra against Cobra Commander.
  • Faction: Cobra — Serpentor seizes Cobra from Cobra Commander as a genetically built emperor.

What is Serpentor?

Serpentor is the composite emperor Dr. Mindbender grows from the DNA of conquerors, a sun-disk tyrant who splits Cobra in a civil war against Cobra Commander.

Key threads lead to Dr. Mindbender, Cobra Commander and Cobra.
